faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Before You Contact Us, Read This.

items.question: How do I choose the right pipe size?
items.answer: Choosing the right pipe size depends on several factors, including the type of irrigation system, water flow rate, required pressure, and pipeline length. For more accurate guidance, send your project specifications to the AgriFlow team.

items.question: Do you provide services for farms and agricultural sites?
items.answer: AgriFlow specializes in providing products and equipment for irrigation systems and agricultural applications. Contact our team to learn more about the products and services available for your project.

items.question: Can I request a price quotation for a project?
items.answer: Yes. You can send your project details, required products, and technical specifications through our contact form or call us directly. Our team will review your quotation request.

items.question: Do you provide installation support?
items.answer: To learn more about technical guidance and equipment installation support, contact the AgriFlow team. We will provide the relevant information based on your products and project requirements.
